messages:
DeployBot: Pager — deploy.canary failed for service:web-api (canary=3->4). error=artifact checksum mismatch, pulling sha256 mismatch :warning:
Jamie (oncall): acked. oncall taking. investigating.
Jamie (oncall): @DeployBot can we pause traffic to canary set? need kill-switch if this is widespread
DeployBot: traffic frozen for canary group id=web-api-canary-3 :white_check_mark:
Lee (build-eng): seeing CI job #4421 produced image tag `web-api:staging-20260315` with two different digests in different registries. expected sha256:abcd1234 got sha256:ef011234 on eu-registry.
Lee (build-eng): prob a mirror race + mutable tag push, might be a race in the promotion step.
Aisha (sre): good call on pausing traffic. Jamie — suggest immediate feature-flag kill for new-render until we confirm. less blast radius.
Jamie (oncall): /ff disable new-render --global  # kill-switch executed :rotating_light:
InfraBot: feature flag 'new-render' disabled (confirmed).
Pablo (pm): any customer visible impact yet? Maya please confirm CS standby.
Maya (cs): CS sees a small spike of 503s in EU regions from 02:10-02:14 UTC, ~1% of requests. Ticket created: CS-5789, customers notified with short statement.
Jamie (oncall): starting rollback to canary=2 -> full canary stop then promote previous stable digest. planning commands:
```
# pin to digest from registry-primary
kubectl set image deploy/web-api web-api=eu.gcr.io/redwood/web-api@sha256:abcd1234 -n prod
kubectl rollout status deploy/web-api -n prod
```
Jamie (oncall): triggering rollout now.
Lee (build-eng): holding new CI promotions. checking pipeline logs. found step `promote-artifact` retried and pushed mutable tag after rebase, didn't wait for digest consistency. adding gate.
InfraBot: registry GC/replication lag visible between primary and eu mirror. TTL on mirror sync was 30s, observed 2-min lag during burst.
Aisha (sre): recommend: 1) rollback to pinned digest 2) purge eu mirror cache 3) re-run promote with immutable tag (timestamp+sha) 4) validate canary on eu only at 1% then scale.
Jamie (oncall): rollback complete, rollout status OK :white_check_mark:. brief spike in errors stopped.
Lee (build-eng): I'll push a follow-up patch to CI: enforce `promote-artifact` to push immutable tag and verify digest equality across mirrors before completing.
Pablo (pm): good. let's capture RCA and a short customer-facing blurb. Maya to coordinate.
Maya (cs): sending update now: "We observed a brief deployment issue affecting a subset of EU traffic. We rolled back the canary and stabilized service; monitoring continues."
Jamie (oncall): handing off to Aisha for postmortem and next-window follow-ups. key action items pinned: 
- Lee: CI gating + immutable tags (PR #1287)
- Infra: increase mirror consistency check + alert on >30s replication lag
- SRE/Aisha: run canary revalidation after CI patch, schedule controlled redeploy
- CS/Maya: follow-up customer note in 4hrs
Aisha (sre): taking handoff. leaving runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-artifact-rollback (see steps 2-6). will coordinate RCA and ops timeline.
Jamie (oncall): thx all. paging cleared. :thumbsup:
